subject: Pass formatting to UI function/ variables

messages.author: 34d1b12964c01466
messages.subject: Pass formatting to UI function/ variables
parts:
Is there a way to pass formatting to UI input functions, such as color, or *better yet* to add shapes?

For example, the code below passes a the vector car make/models from mtcars to checkboxGroupInput in a sidebarPanel.   It plots hp and disp in the mainPanel, with fill colors having been assigned to the df via brewer.pal.

I would like to EITHER/BOTH: 

1) color code the display text of the checkbox vars, using the assign brewer pal colors, or

2) add a colored shape to the right of each checkbox var in the sidebarPanel, effectively making a interactive legend.

Thank you.

My minimal code:

ui.R
shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
sidebarPanel(
checkboxGroupInput("choice",
                 "Choices",
                 my_mtcars$model, selected = my_mtcars$model[1])),
mainPanel(  
plotOutput("plot1"),
    )
  )
)

server.R
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Tidy up
my_mtcars <- mtcars %>% mutate(model = rownames(mtcars))

# Assign some colors to each car
getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, 'RdBu'))
my_mtcars %<>% mutate(model.color = getPalette(length(unique(my_mtcars$model))))

shinyServer(function(input, output,session) {
  
  sub=reactive(my_mtcars %>% filter(model %in% input$choice))
    
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot(ggplot(sub(),aes_string(x=quote(hp), y = quote(disp))) +
xlim(c(min(my_mtcars$hp), max(my_mtcars$hp))) + 
ylim(c(min(my_mtcars$disp), max(my_mtcars$disp))) +
geom_point(size = 4, shape = 22, fill = sub()$model.color)
)
  
  })
